summary: Gayla Carney and Jana Addison, two experienced hiker-teachers, lost the descent trail coming down from a 14,345-ft Blanca Peak summit on Thursday July 9, descending the wrong side of the ridge into Blanca Basin; commercial helicopter flyover located them Friday but ground teams could not reach them in the dark; both were cold, hungry and weak after two nights out
location: Blanca Peak descent / Blanca Basin, Sangre de Cristo Range
responding_agency: Huerfano County Sheriff's Office; CO Army National Guard HAATS (UH-60 Black Hawk Talon 39 hoist via jungle penetrator); Flight for Life (located pair, passed coordinates)
notes: Mission spans 2015-07-09 (lost Thursday) through 2015-07-11 (5 p.m. Saturday hoist rescue); dates weekday-verified; county = Huerfano per the Huerfano County Sheriff's lead-agency alert (Blanca Basin side ambiguous in the article); incident is Part 1 of the CO National Guard's 3-part SAR series. Run-647 merge: COARNG Part-3 HAATS retrospective (parent-opened) — first mission of the day: two missing hikers near Mt. Blanca (Carney/Addison), FFL located, HAATS crew-chief-down hoist from rescue seat, no injuries stated. run 671: parent-opened AVSAR 2008-2015 archive documents the July 9-11 2015 Blanca Basin two-lost-hikers Blackhawk-hoist mission
